description: PITTSTON, PA — Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s campaign today announced that he has earned the endorsement of Amalgamated Transit Union (ATU), representing transit workers including bus drivers, mechanics, and rail operators across Pennsylvania. The endorsement adds to a growing coalition of labor unions supporting Bresnahan’s campaign for re-election.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Bresnahan Earns Endorsement from Amalgamated Transit Union - Rob for PA
